notes: Three branches meet at «جميعا عن نافع، عن ابن عمر» after the last taḥwil: that tail is shared
«كلهم عن أيوب» is written only for the second branch, so the first branch is read as ending at إسماعيل before the tail; the text does not say it passed Ayyub
Glosses «يعني ابن علية» and «- يعني ابن عثمان -» are left out
Wording variants («فإني أخاف» / «مخافة أن يناله العدو») are not transmitter variants: left out
